messages:
Alex: Hey team — I need to swap my Sunday on-call (10:00–18:00 PT). Family thing in the morning; offline ~09:30–13:30. I can cover 14:00–18:00 if someone takes 10:00–14:00. Sorry for the short notice.
Maria: I can pick up 10:00–14:00. Quick Q: any rollouts or migrations during that window? I want to know risk level before I confirm.
Alex: Thanks @Maria. No prod deploys planned, but there is a staging Postgres migration at Sun 11:30 — ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3142. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Oncall+Runbook.
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Temporary handoff in progress — Alex -> Maria for 10:00–14:00. Please update handoff doc and calendar.
Lee: I can shadow Maria 12:00–14:00 in case the migration needs extra hands. Can someone prewarm the demo cache before 11:30? Minimal command: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/demo/prefetch`
Maria: Thanks @Lee — I'll run the prefetch at 11:00. Alex, can you paste a one-line list of risks/notes you want me to watch?
Alex: Short handoff notes: 1) Staging Postgres migration @11:30 — watch tx timeout + connection pool. 2) Demo route cache key: `demo-route-prefetch`. 3) If latency spikes, fallback route to smaller model: set routing policy to `model=alpine-7b-q4` in Console or use the CLI `redwood routing set --policy fallback=alpine-7b-q4`. 4) PD escalation: paging policy is standard sev2->sev1. Playbooks and keys: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Handoffs-and-Runbooks
Olivia: :thumbsup: I can cover 14:00–18:00 if plans change or Maria needs to sign off early.
Maria: Got it. I'll update the oncall calendar and ping PagerDuty with the temporary swap. Quick checklist for whoever is covering the migration: run `scripts/watch_migration.sh`, monitor `tail -f /var/log/inference/*.log`, and check the DB pool metrics dashboard.
Alex: Appreciate it all — leaving phone on for urgent DMs. If you need me, DM me with prefix "ONCALL:" so I see it immediately.
Maria: Updated calendar and posted rotation in #eng-oncall. Added link to ticket + runbook. Thanks @Alex — enjoy your morning.
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Handoff completed and recorded. Reminder: set Slack status to "on-call" and update PagerDuty coverage if needed.
